messages:
maria-partnerships: Hey team — starting coordination for a Lima (Peru) edge + marketplace onboarding with LocalCloud partner Conexa. Need quota approval, hardware footprint (equivalent to 4xA100), and a joint announcement window. Can owners chime in?

dan-eng: SGTM. Do we have exact expected RPS or concurrency? that will drive the SKU sizing and quota ask.

maria-partnerships: Good q. Conexa estimates initial pilot ~200 concurrent sessions, peak ~350, typical seq length 512 tokens. They want dedicated racks in Equinix LIMA1 and optional bump to 8xA100 if adoption is strong.

sam-cloud-ops: 200–350 concurrent at 512 is reasonable with 4xA100 per cluster if we do batching and KV cache. Need marketplace quota request to the cloud provider and a private capacity request for Dedicated. I'll open infra tickets.

li-ops: @sam-cloud-ops pls list exact quota lines and IAM roles Conexa needs. Also we need Entitlement SKU for the marketplace listing — legal review required.

andres-conexa: happy to share Conexa's onboarding doc. We also need a co-marketing timeline — Conexa prefers late-May window.

maria-partnerships: Noted. Target timeline: internal gating by 05/10, provider quota confirmed by 05/20, announcement 05/30. Is that feasible?

dan-eng: 05/10 gating OK if infra can turn around provider-side requests quickly. Will need the SKU to be pinned: `redwood-lima-edge-dedicated-v1` (placeholder).

sam-cloud-ops: Opening provider quota request now. Ticket: PROV-7891. Payload I'm submitting: 
```
region: lq1-lima
requested_hardware: 4xA100
expected_concurrency: 350
workload: low-latency inference, seq_len=512
marketplace_sku: redwood-lima-edge-dedicated-v1
partner: Conexa
```

sam-cloud-ops: deploy-bot created PROV-7891 with provider and assigned to vendor-ops.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PROV-7891 and pinged vendor-ops@provider for quota confirmation.

kali-legal: I can take the marketplace entitlement review this week. Need the draft MSA addendum and the SKU + pricing cap. Please drop in #legal-queue or attach here.

maria-partnerships: attaching draft MSA addendum in the doc repo: https://internal.docs/repo/lima-conexa-msa-draft (note: internal link). Pricing cap draft: $0.16/token-equivalent for dedicated usage during pilot.

li-ops: Noted. For IAM: Conexa service account needs roles: `redwood.edge.deploy`, `redwood.logs.write`, and read-only access to billing metrics. We'll include a minimal role-binding script.

andres-conexa: we'll provision a Conexa integration app and share the client ID + redirect URIs once legal confirms.

sam-cloud-ops: Provider responded — provisional quota approved pending compliance checklist. ETA 48–72h. Marking PROV-7891 status: awaiting-compliance.

managers: @maria-partnerships can you confirm who will run the on-site validation with Conexa in LIMA?

maria-partnerships: Andres and Conexa will run the first day; Dan will lead Redwood validation remotely, Li will handle logs and metrics config. I'll schedule the session 05/18.

dan-eng: I'll prepare a short validation checklist: perf smoke, model correctness tests, KV cache sanity, and autoscale stress.

kali-legal: Reviewed MSA addendum, small edits requested (data residency clause + opt-out for telemetry). Uploaded comments to the doc.

maria-partnerships: thanks @kali-legal. Can you approve final version by EOD tomorrow so we can push to Conexa?

kali-legal: aiming for EOD tomorrow.

sam-cloud-ops: provider updated PROV-7891 -> quota-approved (provisional). Next: provisioning window.

li-ops: I'll draft the role-binding script and config snippet here: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: conexa-edge-binding
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: conexa-integration
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: redwood-edge-minimal
```

andres-conexa: Great. Conexa is aligned on the May dates. We'll share our test keys by 05/15. Also want to confirm joint blog: marketing will do short technical post + customer quote.

maria-partnerships: I'll loop in marketing after legal sign-off. Proposed cadence: tech post 05/30, press outreach 06/02.

dan-eng: One more ask — hardware partner Equinix wants the rack layout and power draw estimate. Sam or Li can you provide that?

sam-cloud-ops: Will share rack/power doc by EOD tomorrow (include PUE and rackU).

maria-partnerships: Awesome — owners: Sam (provider quota + rack doc), Li (IAM + logging), Dan (validation checklist), Kali (legal), Andres (Conexa lead). I'll keep this thread as the single source-of-truth. If anything blocks, ping me. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Reminder — agenda sync scheduled: 2026-05-12 15:00 UTC, meeting id 112-445.

li-ops: added runbook stub to infra repo: https://internal.repo/runbooks/lima-edge-runbook (placeholder).

maria-partnerships: closing loop for now — next updates in PROV-7891 and legal comments. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
